title: 高盛Ian Draiden：亚洲三大市场，哪个最让他兴奋？
speaker: Ian Draiden

segments.en: Yeah, but I think that based on our conversations with issuers and when I look at our pipeline. I'm sure this is the same across the street. It feels as though activity levels are set to continue. I do think that the path though is not going to be linear.
segments.zh: 是的，但根据我们与发行人的交流以及我们的项目储备，我相信整个行业都是如此。感觉活动水平将继续。但我确实认为路径不会是一条直线。

segments.en: Okay, in terms of markets, I mean you travel all the time you were telling us here. But you also you call Hong Kong. I think Japan used to be your former home as well. I mean where are you seeing the most where are you most excited about which market? I've been in Asia for a long time 28 years. Okay, I was in Tokyo for 12 Hong Kong for the last 16.
segments.zh: 就市场而言，你经常出差，你也常驻香港。日本曾是你的家。你最看好哪个市场？我在亚洲很久了，28年。在东京12年，香港16年。

segments.en: I travel across the region we run one integrated investment banking business. So you know, just in the last couple of weeks. I was in Tokyo at the end of last week. I was in Seoul earlier in the week. And then Shanghai before that different countries different companies.
segments.zh: 我走遍整个地区，我们运营一个整合的投行业务。过去几周，我上周末在东京，本周初在首尔，之前在上海。不同国家、不同公司。

segments.en: Nuances, but I think themes remain quite similar. So as it relates to equity capital markets activity. This tech this kind of AI super cycle for sure that that is common across these countries.
segments.zh: 有细微差别，但主题相当相似。就权益资本市场活动而言，科技和AI超级周期在这些国家是共同的。

segments.en: Financial sponsors and particularly encouraged. By in the sense that financial sponsor MNA as a percentage of total MNA so far this year. It's about 24% up from 2025, which was around 19%.
segments.zh: 财务赞助人尤其受到鼓舞。今年迄今为止，财务赞助人并购占总并购的比例约为24%，高于2025年的约19%。
